scope_limits: Complete named mathematical proof bodies are retained. The source inventory does not assert a fresh proof review of every copied equation.
Original supplied SGA NOTE remains historical; NOTE_corrected and the exact correction recipe govern the mathematical embedding.

Standard primary literature citations and contextual source-reading discussions are retained as citations; no copyrighted primary scans or private corpus transcripts are bundled.
Saved checker outputs and reviews retain their original historical execution/read scope; this task performed no rerun.
